subject: Kickoff: Vendor onboarding — remit channel selection, ACH vs Wire, PO integration
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elise Tanner <elise.tanner@coppertech.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-15T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: Vendor onboarding — remit channel selection, ACH vs Wire, PO integration

Hi Elise,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get CopperTech set up. I wanted to kick off the procurement onboarding so Finance and Sales Ops can capture the banking and invoice routing details we need to start sending POs and payments. High-level items we need to confirm: 

- Preferred payment channel: ACH or Wire (and if wire, give SWIFT/IBAN where applicable)
- Bank name/account number + a PDF bank form or voided check for validation
- Remittance email address(es) for invoice submission and remittance advice
- Invoicing cadence and payment terms (e.g., Net 30)
- PO requirements: is a PO number required on the invoice? Any PO field mapping (project code, site code)?
- Any special AP contacts or vendor codes for your ERP

Can you please confirm the above and attach any bank form and W‑9 (or equivalent)? Laura (Finance) and Ben (Sales Ops) are looped in to capture any PO mapping and payables setup needs.

Proposed next steps once we have those items:
1) We’ll ingest bank form and verify ACH routing (or store wire details if required).
2) Redwood Finance will confirm vendor code and payment terms.
3) Sales Ops will validate PO mapping for automated matching and provide a sample PO/invoice template.

If you prefer a short call this week to walk through the fields, we can do 20 minutes.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Manager, Procurement Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment placeholders: none yet]

From: Elise Tanner <elise.tanner@coppertech.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: CopperTech AP <ap@coppertech.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T10:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Vendor onboarding — remit channel selection, ACH vs Wire, PO integration

Hi Rishi (and team),

Great — happy to get this moving. Answers below and I attached the bank form and our W‑9.

- Preferred payment method: ACH domestic payments for US invoices. For international payments we prefer SWIFT wires (we’ll provide IBAN/SWIFT on request).
- Bank: First Harbor Bank
  - Routing: 123456789
  - Account: 987654321
  - Account name: CopperTech Inc.
- Remittance email: ap@coppertech.com (please include remit@coppertech.com on the invoice CC if you send remittance notifications)
- Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice date (exceptions require prior approval)
- PO: Yes, we require a PO number on the invoice for automated matching; PO should populate the PO field and the invoice needs the project_code in the memo line if applicable. Our AP system expects PO in field: PO_NUMBER.
- AP contacts: Elise Tanner (elise.tanner@coppertech.com) and AP inbox above.

Two notes: 
1) We prefer PDF invoices submitted to ap@coppertech.com — we can accept emailed invoices and automated SFTP drop for partners later if needed.
2) For ACH verification, we can provide a bank letter or a voided check. I attached a signed bank form and our W‑9.

Attachments: CopperTech_Bank_Form.pdf, CopperTech_W9.pdf

If you want, we can confirm PO field mapping in a 15‑minute screen share.

Thanks,
Elise
Director, Finance Operations
CopperTech
[Attachment: CopperTech_Bank_Form.pdf (pdf), CopperTech_W9.pdf (pdf)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elise Tanner <elise.tanner@coppertech.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Vendor onboarding — remit channel selection, ACH vs Wire, PO integration

Elise — perfect, thanks for the quick detail and attachments. A couple follow-ups from our side (so Finance Ops can configure):

- For ACH verification we’ll accept the bank form you attached. Laura, can you confirm whether Redwood needs micro‑deposits for this vendor or if we can proceed with the uploaded bank form?
- Ben — for Sales Ops: can you confirm whether the PO_NUMBER should be included in the invoice header and whether Redwood should also include a custom field called project_code when we generate POs programmatically? If CopperTech needs a specific header name for automated parsing, note that as well.
- Elise — can you confirm if CopperTech supports receipts/remittance advice at a second email address (remit@coppertech.com) in addition to the AP inbox? We’ll send remittance advice when payments are issued.

Action items I’ll take once we have the confirmations:
- Create vendor record in Redwood Finance with ACH details, Net 30, and attach the bank form + W‑9.
- Update PO template to include PO_NUMBER and project_code in the metadata block.
- Share a sample PDF invoice format for CopperTech to validate matching rules.

If no objections, I’ll schedule a 15‑minute PO mapping call at 1:00pm PT today — I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Rishi

From: CopperTech AP <ap@coppertech.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elise Tanner <elise.tanner@coppertech.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-15T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Vendor onboarding — remit channel selection, ACH vs Wire, PO integration

Hi Rishi/Team,

Confirming the receipt of bank form and W‑9 — ACH is preferred for US payments. remit@coppertech.com is our remittance address and should be CC’d on any invoice submission or remittance advice. We accept PDF invoices via email to ap@coppertech.com.

Notes for Redwood:
- Please include PO_NUMBER in the invoice header exactly as shown (field name PO_NUMBER).
- If you send bulk invoices, please include a CSV with invoice IDs and amounts to speed reconciliation.
- Wire instructions for non‑US payments: reach out to ap@coppertech.com and we’ll provide SWIFT/IBAN for that invoice batch.

Thanks — we’ll be standing by for the sample invoice and your vendor code.

Regards,
CopperTech Accounts Payable
[Attachment: none]
